description: All snap_* tables are precomputed for purchases 2017-01..2018-08. They are NOT recalculated by date, state or seller slicers.
Latest event timestamp in the extract (used to classify open orders).
Late rate of all delivered-in-window orders (state level reference).
Late rate of single-seller delivered-in-window orders (lane and seller reference).
Low-score (1-2 star) share among on-time reviewed single-seller orders.
Minimum excess late orders for 'Investigate'. An OPERATIONAL SCREENING POLICY, not statistical significance.
A half with fewer than 30 orders is 'unverified', which is not a negative result.
Northeast-bound means the DESTINATION (customer) state is in the Northeast; origin is irrelevant.
Only 2 of 8 Investigate sellers remain Investigate when the three high-delay months are excluded.
Low-score measures use single-review orders; some reviews are written before delivery; never read as causal.
Regenerate with the script; do not edit by hand.
